title: Studio
lead: Draft claims and sources, send them for review and follow what happens next.

new.claimLead: Describe the claim as people make it. Evidence is added once its sources are published.
new.sourceLead: Record where evidence comes from. Reviewers check a source before it is published.

note.draft: Only you can see this draft. Send it for review when it is ready.
note.pending_review: An admin is reviewing this. It can't be edited until the review is finished.
note.changes_requested: An admin asked for changes. Edit it, then send it for review again.
note.published: This is published. Changes to published content go through a new review.
note.rejected: This was rejected and can no longer be edited.

hints.claimTitle: Write the claim in one sentence, the way people say it.
hints.origin: A newspaper, a post, a speech or another place the claim appeared.

submit.title: Ready for review?
submit.body: An admin checks it before it is published. You can't edit it while it is in review.

duplicate.title: Similar sources already exist
duplicate.body: Check that you are not adding the same source twice.

errors.invalid: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.dates: The access date cannot be earlier than the publication date.
errors.locked: This item can no longer be edited.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.nochange: Nothing has changed. Edit at least one field.
errors.failed: This could not be saved. Try again.
